name: Hua Du Zhi Lian
source:
In 1920, Lian Feng, a well-off young Chinese student, with the support of his family, participated in the movement to stay in France organized by the government of the Republic of China. He met and fell in love with Alice, a working girl from a poor family, in Paris.

This love was opposed by the Lian family. Lian Feng resolutely cut off economic exchanges with the family, worked and studied with Alice, and became independent. Although they were poor, their feelings became stronger in the process.

[Edited From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846630/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1920年，家境优渥的中国青年学生廉丰，在家人的支持下参加了中华民国政府组织的留法运动。他在巴黎结识了出身贫寒的打工女孩爱丽丝，并与她坠入爱河。

这段恋情遭到了廉家的反对。廉丰毅然断绝了与家里的经济往来，与爱丽丝一同勤工俭学、自食其力。生活虽清贫，两人的感情却在相伴奋斗的过程中愈发深厚。

[编译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846630/_/]Steam[/url]]
